title: Monitoring or Blocking Outbound Content by Data Size

blocks.text: You might want to leverage Zscaler's Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policy to monitor or block specific types of outbound content by file size, without scanning for specific files within the content. For example, you could block outbound image files (such as GIF or JPEG). In Internet Access > Policy > File Type Control, you can set the policy to block image files. You can set the policy to block images on the File Type Control page.

For this scenario, you can leverage the Rule Without Content Inspection policy option. When configuring the policy, you can specify the criteria Zscaler uses for monitoring or blocking content, but refrain from specifying an ICAP server. Zscaler monitors or blocks outbound content based on the criteria you specify, but does not send content to any external DLP engines.
